value.definition: a state that holds only while it is kept true

directives.name: Move When False
directives.act: Move a design entry to intent, or delete it, as soon as you find it no longer true.
directives.warrant: Design is read as true now, so one that has gone false misleads until somebody tests it.
aids: Move it if still meant, delete it if not.
Never note the exception where it broke.

value.definition: an invariant that does not hold yet

directives.name: Resolve When Found
directives.act: Move or delete an intent entry as soon as you find it true, not when the work on it closes.
directives.warrant: Nothing re-reads an entry, so one that came true and stayed sends someone at a gap already shut.
aids: Check the whole claim, not just the case you met.
Resolve the entry you found, not the section.
